items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: it's through that organization I got my first training is conducting under Louie Teo.

ctx.x: Now this is a conducting course under Lorenzo Teo.

Yes, that's, we had in those days an organization known as the Club Lyri. That was composed of a symphonic orchestra. People who played just for the love of music. It was a non-profit organization. Their sole purpose was to sponsor talented young people. We used to give two concerts a year, and whenever we found a talented person, we would sponsor them. We sent, I remember we sent one boy to Europe, pianist. And, I don't know, we've never found out what really happened. He died the week that he was to graduate,…
mouth. But that was organization, it's through that organization I got my first training is conducting under Louie Teo. Is it Louie or Lorenzo? Louie. Louie. Yes.
